title: Lineage-Aware Search Control for LLM-Based Evolutionary Factor Mining
abstract: arXiv:2610.29663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Formulaic alpha factor mining searches for symbolic expressions that transform market data into predictive signals. Recent LLM-based evolutionary factor mining methods use large language models as semantic variation operators. Under the conventional LLM-EA paradigm, stochastic variation and fitness-based selection can leave the search weakly directed and concentrated around a narrow set of structurally similar factors. We argue that these limitations arise because current methods mainly organize search at the individual and population levels, leaving lineage-level control underused. A lineage connects successive factor variants through evolutionary descent. We propose LineageEvo, which uses lineage in two coupled forms of search control: (1) lineage-conditioned LLM variation, which distills Lineage-Scoped Search Experience into operator-specific priors and fuses them with global operator priors, providing persistent, lineage-relevant g

translated_title: 面向大语言模型进化因子挖掘的谱系感知搜索控制
translated_abstract: 公式化Alpha因子挖掘旨在搜索能够将市场数据转化为预测信号的符号表达式。近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的进化因子挖掘方法将大语言模型用作语义变异算子。在传统的LLM-进化算法（LLM-EA）范式下，随机变异和基于适应度的选择可能导致搜索方向性薄弱，并使搜索集中围绕一小组结构相似的因子。我们认为，这些局限性的产生是因为现有方法主要在个体和种群层面组织搜索，而谱系层面的控制未被充分利用。谱系通过进化传承将连续的因子变体连接起来。我们提出LineageEvo，它以两种相互耦合的搜索控制形式来利用谱系：（1）谱系条件化的LLM变异，将谱系范围搜索经验提炼为算子特定先验，并将其与全局算子先验融合，从而提供持续的、与谱系相关的指导……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出LineageEvo框架，通过谱系条件化的LLM变异将谱系范围搜索经验提炼为算子先验并与全局先验融合，为LLM进化因子挖掘引入谱系层面的搜索控制，克服了传统方法搜索方向性弱、因子结构同质化的局限。
en_tdlr: LineageEvo introduces lineage-aware search control for LLM-based evolutionary factor mining by using lineage-conditioned LLM variation that distills Lineage-Scoped Search Experience into operator-specific priors fused with global priors, overcoming weakly directed search and structural homogenization.
